neighbours.label: (sub-trigger of a broad pole) ' wonder' opening a hook: 'Ever wonder what'
fire: Ever wonder what makes bread rise so fast?
Ever wonder why cats purr at night?
Have you ever wonder how bees find flowers?
Ever wonder where old phones go?
Ever wonder what your dog is thinking?
Ever wonder how planes stay up?
Ever wonder why the sky turns red?
Ever wonder who invented the zipper?
quiet: Ever since I learned what makes bread rise I bake.
Ever since then cats purr at night.
Have you ever seen how bees find flowers?
Ever since May old phones go there.
Ever since Monday your dog is eating.
Ever since then planes stay up.
Ever seen how the sky turns red?
Ever since then we have used the zipper.

notes: The card flags this pole broad. Probes: ' wonder' 0.51, ' clean' 0.33, ' which' 0.29; plain 0.04-0.07. Only one piece. ' Napoli' alone is one token, so the test uses hyphenated route names.
